assertions.requirement: Specs select only the closed member and assert its completion; capabilities, profile resolution and lifecycle policy remain in the existing family.
assertions.candidateEvidence: test/integration/e2e/internal/: job-policy.ts; targets/job-profiles.ts; closed-spec ESLint and discovery regressions.

assertions.requirement: Cleanup intent and complete inventory fencing precede every actual CLI create. Preserve original controller, credential, placement, legal provisional transitions, ended attempts, partial history and lost replies; never replay an unknown send.
assertions.candidateEvidence: test/integration/e2e/internal/: JobAttemptLedger; JobNativeCleanup; PublicCloudJobTransport; WorkloadMutationTransport; actual CLI parser and partial-history regressions.

assertions.requirement: Require an original live Running record and native attempt, requested and resolved placement, and the actual Docker image configuration before extension work. Terminal-before-active evidence cannot satisfy these resource-dependent extensions.
assertions.candidateEvidence: test/integration/e2e/internal/: DedicatedJobContract.#cloudProgress; JobRecords.progress; exact native credential/identity and imageConfigDigest reader; terminal/foreign/optional placement regressions.

assertions.requirement: Only the family finalizer claims each original run/reference/generation-bound progress and required extension once, then releases all children and resources and emits one completion. Copied, missing, mismatched, early and reused records reject.
assertions.candidateEvidence: test/integration/e2e/internal/: JobRecords begin/progress/extension/terminal/claim and DedicatedJobContract.#finalize; existing ownership and finalizer controls.

assertions.requirement: Require persisted terminal cleanup, complete native history and exact provider absence before release. Independent teardown cancellation and remaining deadlines retain primary and secondary failures. Credentials outlive their dependent resources; rescue cannot replace failed automatic-cleanup proof.
assertions.candidateEvidence: test/integration/e2e/internal/: Existing JobNativeCleanup, credential/session owners and cleanup stack; raw fixture-record, cleanup-observations, attempt/native/resource readback regressions.

assertions.requirement: Register original bootstrap API credential intent before import. Sanitize actual child environments and suppress secret-producing output before artifact recording; exact original-controller API absence gates credential release. No unrelated storage credential is acquired for members without storage.
assertions.candidateEvidence: test/integration/e2e/internal/: PublicCloudJobTransport; JobAuthorization; JobPrivateCommands/isolatedJobEnvironment; real Lambda MACE no-AWS preparation; redaction and original-controller controls.

assertions.requirement: The named live forced failure produces no completion. Retain compact success and failure records at least 30 days with exact source/profile/run/attempt/generation and durations; inspect inner outcomes and raw cleanup registrations before cleanup backstops.
assertions.candidateEvidence: test/integration/e2e/internal/: GPU/GHCR Job workflow cells, unchanged companion/backstop authority and protected job-comparison-evidence prefix; workflow/retention regressions. No live result or formal qualification is claimed by this map.

assertions.requirement: Preserve the held Ubuntu 24.04 GPU Job on Standard_NC4as_T4_v3/westus2 with 100 GiB high-tier disk, on-demand by default, and a separately pinned MACE probe image. Preserve original validated VM/region/disk/spot and probe inputs; spot retains its owned checkpoint cleanup.
assertions.candidateEvidence: test/integration/e2e/internal/: ghcrProbe capability, JobMemberProfile.ghcr and actual CLI parsing for both spot modes; unsupported profile and pinned-image controls.

assertions.requirement: Resolve the declared GHCR digest to linux/amd64 layer facts with private anonymous authorization, bounded reads and redirect/schema checks. Preserve the original VM auto-resolution fallback with imageBytes=0 and the original resolution failure; unknown bytes cannot invent comparable baseline throughput.
assertions.candidateEvidence: test/integration/e2e/internal/: JobGhcrTransport.prepare/#imageFacts with existing TargetHttpClient; pinned index/layer, private token, fallback and image fact identity controls.

assertions.requirement: Pin the original Workload SSH endpoint, key and captured host key once; reject a foreign Workload/IP before key creation or commands. Every foreground probe verifies the original live native row/credential/placement before and after; cleanup uses this original host and independent cancellation. Sanitize the actual initial and subsequent SSH child environments and suppress raw command recording before execution.
assertions.candidateEvidence: test/integration/e2e/internal/: Existing RemoteExecutor.pinHost expectedHost and per-command deadline/signal/private-output options preserve Service defaults; JobGhcrTransport bind and public transport owner; shared Service and foreign-attempt regressions. Real ProcessRunner child regression verifies ambient provider credentials are absent from both the initial pin and later commands, with zero raw command artifacts.

assertions.requirement: Run the unchanged probe-ghcr-throughput.sh on the original host with 268435456 sample bytes and ladder 1/4/8/16 by default. Preserve original overrides, private output, fingerprints and a named throughput verdict; a failing or incomplete payload cannot pass.
assertions.candidateEvidence: test/integration/e2e/internal/: JobGhcrTransport.throughput and jobGhcrThroughput; shared payload byte and malformed verdict controls; raw PROBE output retained in its existing format.

assertions.requirement: Record unit intent before sending the unchanged containerd payload through the original detached systemd unit. Preserve its EXIT status trap, 1200/2400-second pull timeout, 15-second polling and whole 3600/5400-second runner budget. Reject malformed/nonzero/truncated replies and three consecutive terminal unit reads without an exit record; retain lost starts and partial diagnostics.
assertions.candidateEvidence: test/integration/e2e/internal/: JobGhcrTransport startPull/poll/capture with existing cleanup stack and pinned SSH; family wait/rejection/remaining deadline; lost-send, cancellation, terminal-without-status and partial nonzero SSH controls.

assertions.requirement: Require exit zero, Docker visibility PASS, verdict SUPPORTED and the shared payload cleanup PASS before accepting the pull. Daemon rescue or subsequent VM deletion cannot erase a failed automatic-cleanup assertion.
assertions.candidateEvidence: test/integration/e2e/internal/: jobGhcrPull canonical predicates; existing probe-containerd-parallel-pull.sh; failed automatic cleanup and primary/secondary cleanup regressions.

assertions.requirement: Keep baseline disabled by default and record whether it was requested. If enabled, require one error-free cold baseline, finite positive transfer/baseline rates, and transfer strictly faster. Reject missing, cached, malformed, zero, equal/slower and undeclared baseline observations.
assertions.candidateEvidence: test/integration/e2e/internal/: JobGhcrProfile and jobGhcrPull; both workflow legs bind identical baseline input/budgets; explicit baseline controls.

assertions.requirement: The probe closes only its SSH material; the family owns Job termination/completion/release, and the existing native owner owns VM/unit/daemon cleanup. Register diagnostics before commands, stop/capture only the original unit after cancellation, retain failures and still run native cleanup. Fault after detached launch exercises a live host.
assertions.candidateEvidence: test/integration/e2e/internal/: JobGhcrTransport cleanup registration/finish and family #ghcrMember/#finalize; cleanup after cancelled/lost SSH, material errors and native-owner continuation tests; shared Azure provider lock.
